Safe, steady, and always learning

I have worked in fuel station operations at Oman Oil (OQ) for three years. My day covers safe fueling, HSE rules, supervising shifts, and keeping the station clean and running.

I train new attendants, handle cash and invoicing, and report safety issues early. That is the work I want to grow into a Foreman role, where I can lead a team and improve how the station performs.

Outside the forecourt I work with Microsoft Excel and Word, and I design logos and social media graphics in Photoshop and Illustrator. That mix lets me handle reports and paperwork as well as customers and pumps.
